roles_user_server.name: roles_user_server

roles_user_study.name: roles_user_study
roles_user_study.where: "roles"."study_id" IS NOT NULL AND "roles"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "roles"."email_domain" IS NULL

roles_domain_server.name: roles_domain_server
roles_domain_server.where: "roles"."study_id" IS NULL AND "roles"."user_id" IS NULL AND "roles"."email_domain" IS NOT NULL

roles_everyone_server.name: roles_everyone_server
roles_everyone_server.where: "roles"."study_id" IS NULL AND "roles"."user_id" IS NULL AND "roles"."email_domain" IS NULL

roles_role_fits_context.name: roles_role_fits_context
roles_role_fits_context.value: ("roles"."study_id" IS NULL AND "roles"."role" IN ('researcher', 'admin')) OR ("roles"."study_id" IS NOT NULL AND "roles"."role" IN ('READ', 'WRITE', 'ADMIN'))

roles_admin_by_user.name: roles_admin_by_user
roles_admin_by_user.value: "roles"."role" NOT IN ('admin', 'ADMIN') OR "roles"."user_id" IS NOT NULL
